clippings.speaker: Ari Aster
clippings.quote: I’ve been working with Pawel for a long time—he’s one of my best friends and we understand how the other person works. We have a very satisfying shorthand and our own processes, which is great. I definitely plan on keeping on going with him.
clippings.title: The Ari Aster Q&A
clippings.context: Answering a Letterboxd member's question about whether he'd keep working with Pogorzelski, around the release of Midsommar.

clippings.speaker: Ari Aster
clippings.quote: Pawel spent long days in the field alone before we were shooting, seeing what times were best for the light and which areas and so he was in charge of the schedule day-to-day in terms of what we were shooting.
clippings.title: ‘Midsommar’: How Ari Aster and Pawel Pogorzelski Created a Technicolor Fairy Tale Nightmare
clippings.context: Joint IndieWire craft interview on shooting Midsommar in near-constant summer daylight.

clippings.speaker: Ari Aster
clippings.quote: So logistically, this was definitely the hardest thing I had ever done. And I'm sure it's the hardest thing the cinematographer, Pawel Pogorzelski, had ever done.
clippings.title: Director Ari Aster Dishes on ‘Midsommar’ as New Trailer Debuts: “This Isn’t Hereditary”
clippings.context: Interview on the eve of the Midsommar trailer release, on the difficulty of shooting in daylight.

clippings.speaker: Pawel Pogorzelski
clippings.quote: Well, Ari and I met at AFI in 2008. Almost from the first few weeks, we got a liking of each other's taste in movies. Then, we did a short together at AFI, and knew right away that we wanted to partner up (for other projects).
clippings.title: Interview: Cinematographer Pawel Pogorzelski on Working with Ari Aster to Create HEREDITARY
clippings.context: Interview for the release of Hereditary, on how the two first met as AFI students.

clippings.speaker: Pawel Pogorzelski
clippings.quote: We would jog together and he would pitch me this idea he had for Hereditary , and I thought it was so cool. So, I've been there since the infancy of Hereditary . From the ideas while we were jogging, all the way to the first script, and then on set.
clippings.title: Interview: Cinematographer Pawel Pogorzelski on Working with Ari Aster to Create HEREDITARY
clippings.context: Same interview, on how Aster first pitched Hereditary to him.

clippings.speaker: Pawel Pogorzelski
clippings.quote: Yeah, I hope we keep making movies together for a while. For me, he's family. I love working with. He really pushes the envelope, and I love being part of that.
clippings.title: Interview: Cinematographer Pawel Pogorzelski on Working with Ari Aster to Create HEREDITARY
clippings.context: Same interview, asked about Aster's next film for A24 (Midsommar).

clippings.speaker: Pawel Pogorzelski
clippings.quote: Ari is very prepared and has a very clear vision. We’ll watch a couple movies and send references. He very much knows what he wants, and I have to deliver. What makes me happy is when I show him a test during prep and he says, ‘This is what I wanted but even more.’
clippings.title: Journey of Extremes: Pawel Pogorzelski, 1st AC Dany Racine & Brian Mills on Beau Is Afraid
clippings.context: Panavision interview about the camera and lens work on Beau Is Afraid.
